note: The webcam (UVC) controls SYNQ may set, shared by src/lib/displays/uvc.ts and src-tauri/src/webcams.rs: IAMCameraControl (iface camera) and IAMVideoProcAmp (iface proc) property numbers from ksmedia.h. A value must be inside the range and on the step the camera reports; auto only where the camera says it has one. Vendor extension units, factory defaults and anything else are never sent.
